note: Set A captures the page's substantive control objectives — the generator-torque controller maximizes power capture below rated and the blade-pitch controller regulates generator speed above rated — plus the exclusion of nonpower-production and nacelle-yaw control actions, all of which Set B omits; B instead adds only minor symbol definitions (u, n, x[n]=y[n−1]) and the nacelle-yaw parenthetical. Both sets repeat claims heavily and both contain non-verbatim quotes, but A fabricates quote text in two claims (a "blade-pitch-to-feather" sentence not on the page, and "normal braking functions" where the page says "safety and protection functions") and one truncated fragment, while B misreads the filter coefficient as e^(−2πT_i f_c) instead of T_s and misbinds the "multimegawatt" context to the filter. A's redundancy (the recursion equation and α restated three to five times) is noise, but its coverage of the important engineering facts is stronger.
